package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"io/ioutil"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/prince776/go-dst-kit/realworld"
)

var __w = realworld.New(realworld.Options{})

// The rest of os's filesystem API: the same output whichever World runs it.
func main() {
	top, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "fsmore-*")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("mkdirtemp:", err)
		return
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(top)
	fmt.Println("temp in TempDir:", filepath.Dir(top) == filepath.Clean(os.TempDir()))
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(top, "d"), 0o755)
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(top, "other"), 0o755)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(top, "d", "x.txt"), []byte("hello world"), 0o644)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(top, "other", "secret.txt"), []byte("s"), 0o644)
	os.Symlink(filepath.Join(top, "other"), filepath.Join(top, "link"))

	var walked []string
	filepath.WalkDir(top, func(p string, _ fs.DirEntry, _ error) error {
		if p != top && !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(p), "other") && !strings.Contains(p, "other") {
			walked = append(walked, strings.TrimPrefix(p, top+"/"))
		}
		return nil
	})
	fmt.Println("walk:", strings.Join(walked, " "))
	n := 0
	filepath.Walk(top, func(string, fs.FileInfo, error) error { n++; return nil })
	fmt.Println("walk count:", n)
	m, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(top, "*", "*.txt"))
	fmt.Println("glob:", len(m))

	name := filepath.Join(top, "d", "x.txt")
	os.Chmod(name, 0o600)
	fi, _ := os.Stat(name)
	fmt.Println("mode:", fi.Mode().Perm())
	os.Truncate(name, 5)
	b, _ := os.ReadFile(name)
	fmt.Printf("truncated: %q\n", b)
	mt := time.Date(2001, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0, time.UTC)
	os.Chtimes(name, mt, mt)
	fi, _ = os.Stat(name)
	fmt.Println("mtime:", fi.ModTime().UTC())

	f, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Join(top, "d"), "t-*.log")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("createtemp:", err)
		return
	}
	f.Chmod(0o640)
	f.Close()
	fi, _ = os.Stat(f.Name())
	fmt.Println("temp file mode:", fi.Mode().Perm(), strings.HasSuffix(f.Name(), ".log"))
	d, _ := os.Open(filepath.Join(top, "d"))
	names, _ := d.Readdirnames(-1)
	d.Close()
	fmt.Println("names:", len(names))
	d, _ = os.Open(top)
	infos, _ := d.Readdir(-1)
	d.Close()
	for _, i := range infos {
		if i.Name() == "link" {
			fmt.Println("readdir link is a symlink:", i.Mode()&fs.ModeSymlink != 0)
		}
	}
	sub := os.DirFS(filepath.Join(top, "d"))
	b, err = fs.ReadFile(sub, "x.txt")
	fmt.Printf("dirfs: %q %v\n", b, err)
	old, _ := ioutil.TempDir(top, "old")
	of, _ := ioutil.TempFile(old, "f")
	of.Close()
	es, _ := os.ReadDir(old)
	fmt.Println("ioutil temp:", len(es), slices.Contains([]bool{true}, strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(old), "old")))
}
